Set the thresholds a run will be judged against

Source: R/score.R
agent_thresholds.Rd

Agreed before the run, not chosen afterwards to suit the result. A benchmark that cannot fail is a marketing exercise, and the only defence against that is writing the numbers down first and putting them in version control with the cases.

Usage

agent_thresholds(default = 0.9, ...)

Arguments

default

Numeric in 0 to 1. Applied to any slice not named.

...

Named thresholds, for example `billing = 0.9`.

Value

An object of class `r4agent_thresholds`.

Examples

agent_thresholds(default = 0.85, `not answerable` = 0.95)
#> $default
#> [1] 0.85
#> 
#> $per_slice
#> $per_slice$`not answerable`
#> [1] 0.95
#> 
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "r4agent_thresholds"
